# NextGen DevSecOps AI

## Website
https://mmukul.github.io/

## About
NextGen DevSecOps AI is the training and consulting platform of Mukul Malhotra, focused on DevOps, DevSecOps, Application Security, Generative AI and AI Security.

## Training
- DevOps training: https://mmukul.github.io/curriculum/DevOps-Curriculum-NextGen-DevSecOps-AI.pdf
- DevSecOps & AppSec foundational curriculum: https://mmukul.github.io/curriculum/DevSecOps-Curriculum-NextGen-DevSecOps-AI.pdf
- DevSecOps & AppSec advanced curriculum: https://mmukul.github.io/curriculum/DevSecOps-Advanced-Curriculum-NextGen-DevSecOps-AI.pdf
- Practical Generative AI for Beginners: https://mmukul.github.io/curriculum/Practical-Generative-AI-for-Beginners-NextGen-DevSecOps-AI.pdf

## Topics
DevOps, DevSecOps, AppSec, Secure SDLC, CI/CD Security, SAST, DAST, SCA, Container Security, Cloud Security, GenAI, LLM Security, RAG Security, AI Agents, Prompt Injection, Guardrails, AI Threat Modeling and AI Security.

## Access
Student and administrator portals are private authenticated areas and are not intended for public indexing.
